Solar Pulse | Software, AI & Space Technologies

Solar Pulse is a technology team passionate about software development, artificial intelligence, and space exploration. We aim to create innovative solutions by combining science and technology.

As part of the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we focus on astronaut health, AI-powered systems, and data analysis.

We welcome creative, motivated individuals interested in programming, AI, UI/UX design, and scientific research.

Our mission is to learn, innovate, and shape the future of technology together!
